summary: End-to-end testing of Café Smart Ordering & Management System. All 9 backend pytest cases passed and all 10 UI flows from the review request were verified. Customer flow (menu with 4 categories, add-with-addon, cart, place order with 5% GST), full order lifecycle (PLACED→ACCEPTED→PREPARING→READY→SERVED), reject-with-reason flow, order-more (multiple orders same session), full bill flow (request→lock→10% owner discount→cash payment→PAID→session closed→table AVAILABLE), cashier role-limited discount (percent 403, flat>100 403, flat<=100 OK), tables page (color-coded, Copy QR, Maintenance toggle blocks customer with 423), menu management (sold-out toggle greys item on customer side and removes Add button; add category+item), and WebSocket live update all working correctly.

issues: When a table is toggled to MAINTENANCE while a session object still exists, the card continues to render 'Session: ACTIVE' and the 'Close session (no bill)' link under the MAINTENANCE badge (observed on T2). Cosmetic only; customer QR is correctly blocked (423).

action_items: Optional polish: on Admin Tables page, hide the session summary block (or show 'Session paused') when table.status == MAINTENANCE, since the session shouldn't be visible/actionable during maintenance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 806 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, public/customer, admin/orders, admin/billing, admin/menu, admin/tables) for maintainability.
Bill 'lock' endpoint used by UI is POST /api/admin/bills/{id}/lock, but there is also PATCH /api/admin/bills/{id} handling; frontend is consistent, just noting both paths exist.
Discount role-limit is enforced correctly server-side; frontend does not preemptively disable disallowed options for cashier — could show a hint but functional 403 handling is fine.
Customer TableApp: after order placement, tab auto-switches to 'orders' — this is correct UX; make sure error handling for failed place_order preserves cart (currently seems OK).
